verdict.rationale: Mollie documents payment-specific background automation. The Subscriptions API "automatically create[s] recurring payments for you at the interval you specified", recurring payments "happen in the background", application fees move automatically, and next-gen webhooks let you permanently subscribe to event types to drive your own automated processes. It does not offer a general-purpose automation or agent workflow builder: anything beyond scheduled charges has to be built by the merchant on top of webhooks and the API. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow rules beyond recurring payments, any native scheduled or agentic task runner (MCP server is interactive only), independent hands-on corroboration.
